details: Incident energy (cal/cm2) at the working distance decides the PPE category, not the voltage alone.
Arc rating ATPV is the energy where burn onset is 50 percent probable; EBT is the break-open threshold.
Rubber insulation works by dielectric strength (kV/mm); air breaks down near 3 kV/mm.
Current kills by path and magnitude; insulation and arc ratings address different halves of the hazard.
